content.json:
# RestroPulse - Per-Post API Call Audit

Drill into a single post's AI generation chain. Enter a `postId` and see every API call emitted for that post: surface (LLM / image / video / sonar / calendar), step, model, tokens, cost, latency. Source: Application Insights `customEvents` where `name == 'ai.request.completed'`.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'ai.request.completed'
| extend postId = tostring(customDimensions.postId)
| where postId == '{PostId}'
| extend surface = tostring(customDimensions.surface)
| extend step = tostring(customDimensions.step)
| extend operation = tostring(customDimensions.operation)
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model)
| extend inputTokens = toint(customDimensions.inputTokens)
| extend outputTokens = toint(customDimensions.outputTokens)
| extend costUsd = round(todouble(customDimensions.costUsd), 6)
| extend durationMs = toint(customDimensions.durationMs)
| project timestamp, surface, step, operation, model, inputTokens, outputTokens, costUsd, durationMs
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Call timeline for postId

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'ai.request.completed'
| extend postId = tostring(customDimensions.postId)
| where postId == '{PostId}'
| extend costUsd = todouble(customDimensions.costUsd)
| extend surface = tostring(customDimensions.surface)
| summarize TotalUsd = round(sum(costUsd), 6), Calls = count() by surface
| order by TotalUsd desc
content.title: Cost breakdown by surface for this post

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'ai.request.completed'
| extend postId = tostring(customDimensions.postId)
| where postId == '{PostId}'
| extend durationMs = toint(customDimensions.durationMs)
| extend step = tostring(customDimensions.step)
| project timestamp, step, durationMs
| render barchart kind=unstacked
content.title: Latency per step (ms)
